offering_description.value: Provides in-flight broadband internet and connectivity systems to airlines and business aircraft operators, delivered over satellite and air-to-ground networks, with service plans sold to passengers and aircraft owners.

primary_products.value: aircraft connectivity hardware; in-flight internet service plans; cabin entertainment and content

primary_services.value: installation support; network operations; technical support

customer_segment.value: B2B: airlines, business aircraft operators, aircraft owners and installers

revenue_model.value: product sales: connectivity hardware sold to airlines and aircraft owners; subscription: recurring in-flight internet service plans; service fees: installation, maintenance and support services

value_chain_position.value: service provider: sells connectivity service to airlines and aircraft operators; asset operator: operates its own air-to-ground and satellite network infrastructure; component supplier: sells connectivity equipment for installation on aircraft
value_chain_position.category: service provider; asset operator; component supplier

geography_served.value: global: Airlines and business aircraft operators worldwide, air-to-ground network covers US and Canada

specialization.value: related lines: commercial aviation and business aviation connectivity, sharing equipment and network technology

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: airlines and business aircraft operators; partners / resellers: aircraft manufacturers and installation partners

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: FCC licensing of air-to-ground spectrum, FAA certification of aircraft equipment and installations
